en.label: Technologies Diego uses
en.question: What technologies does Diego use?
en.answer: Python, SQL, and TypeScript; RAG, LangChain/LangGraph, and LLM fine-tuning; FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and W3C DIDs/VCs; Azure OpenAI, Docker, and OpenTelemetry. Full list on the résumé.

es.answer: Python, SQL y TypeScript; RAG, LangChain/LangGraph y ajuste fino de LLM; FastAPI, PostgreSQL y W3C DIDs/VCs; Azure OpenAI, Docker y OpenTelemetry. Lista completa en el currículum.
